text:
Biggest win is usually affected-only builds plus remote cache: PRs touching 1 package stop rebuilding and testing all of them. Ranked by typical payoff/effort [assumed: no tool access to your repo; JS/TS-style monorepo]:

1. affected-only: run build/test/lint only for packages changed vs base + their dependents. Nx `affected`, Turborepo `--filter=...[origin/main]`, Bazel/Pants native
2. remote cache: Turbo/Nx remote cache, Bazel remote cache → unchanged tasks restore in seconds instead of re-running
3. test sharding: split suite across N parallel jobs by timing data. Jest/Vitest `--shard`, Playwright `--shard`, CircleCI/Buildkite timing splits
4. dependency install cache: cache pnpm store / `~/.npm` / `node_modules` keyed on lockfile hash; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline`
5. parallel DAG > serial pipeline: lint, typecheck, unit, build as independent jobs; e2e waits only on build
6. Docker layer cache: BuildKit `--cache-from`/`cache-to type=gha|registry`; deps layer before source copy
7. bigger | self-hosted runners: more cores + warm disk cache. Often 2× for config-only change
8. split fast vs slow gates: PR runs unit + affected e2e; full e2e/matrix runs on merge queue or nightly
9. faster tools: `tsc` → `tsc --build` incremental | `tsgo`; Jest → Vitest; webpack → esbuild/Rspack; eslint → Biome/oxlint for hot rules
10. typecheck once: project references + `tsc -b` instead of per-package full `tsc`
11. kill flaky retries: retries silently add minutes; quarantine flaky tests
12. shallow clone: `fetch-depth` minimal, but deep enough for affected base diff
13. cancel superseded runs: `concurrency: cancel-in-progress` → frees runners, cuts queue wait
14. skip by path: docs-only / config-only PRs skip test jobs

trap: affected-only needs an accurate dependency graph. Undeclared cross-package imports → missed tests → green CI, broken main. Keep a full run on main/merge queue as backstop.

next: profile one 25 min run per job/step. Where the time goes decides the ranking:
- install-heavy → 4
- test-heavy → 1+3
- build-heavy → 2+6
- queue-heavy → 7+13
